method: Manual whole-file reading of6files; bytes matched pinned Git objects. No rendered/UI execution.
findings: Graph page keeps options/custom preset locally, live preview points to local options, and stages copied options/highlight color for commit. Apply notifies graph and selection styles without filesystem rescan.

Graph style selection validated against declared range; brightness/shading/height/scale/light values come from controls/setters, height explicit0..200. Forged widget ranges and numeric setters not yet runtime-qualified.

Preset selection changes appearance while maintaining layout-related options through SetAppearance implementation elsewhere. Invalid preset beyond built-in selects saved custom if present; absence resets displayed matching preset.

Base pane paint delegates OnDraw; context menu preserves current selection if clicked descendant already covered, otherwise requests selection action. Persistent menu commands loop for repeated menu choices.

ControlView owns virtual owner-data native list via typed template, initializes columns/styles, resizes and forwards focus. Model changes switch root, update list styles, sort on size mode, or invalidate display.
Selection notifications deferred to PostSelectionChanged; cached selection correctness still depends on remaining tree/list implementation. UI invalidation is not source content revalidation.
limits: All tracked Pages files now read by declared source method; not proof every setting transaction/render path works.
No Windows UI, preset rendering, focus/selection race or duplicate engine runtime test.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
